cards.front: ¿Le mandaste a Peter los folletos? Sí, le mandé los folletos.
cards.back: Did you send Peter the brochures? Yes, I sent him the brochures.

cards.front: ¿Tu jefa le mandó a Sarah las cifras? Sí, le mandó las cifras.
cards.back: Did your boss send Sarah the figures? Yes, she sent her the figures.

cards.front: ¿Le mandó el cliente a Matt el contrato? Sí, le mandó el contrato.
cards.back: Did the client send Matt the contract? Yes, he sent him the contract.

cards.front: ¿Le has mandado a Peter los folletos? Sí, se los he mandado.
cards.back: Have you sent Peter the brochures? Yes, I've sent them to him.

cards.front: ¿Tu jefa le ha mandado a Sarah las cifras? No, pero se las ha mandado a Marge.
cards.back: Has your boss sent Sarah the figures? No, but she's sent them to Marge.

cards.front: ¿El cliente le ha mandado a Matt el contrato? Sí, se lo ha mandado.
cards.back: Has the client sent Matt the contract? Yes, he's sent it to him.

cards.front: Yo les dije que me lo mandaran.
cards.back: I told them to send it to me.

cards.front: Me dijeron que se lo mandara a ella.
cards.back: They told me to send it to her.

cards.front: Él le dijo a ella que nos lo mandara.
cards.back: He told her to send it to us.

cards.front: Yo antes les mandaba tarjetas de Navidad, pero ya no.
cards.back: I used to send them Christmas cards, but I don't any more.

cards.front: Antes nos mandaban folletos, pero ya no.
cards.back: They used to send us brochures, but they don't any more.

cards.front: La gente antes mandaba cartas, pero ya no.
cards.back: People used to send letters, but they don't any more.

cards.front: ¿Les mandaste algunos? No, no les mandé ninguno.
cards.back: Did you send them any? No, I didn't send them any.

cards.front: ¿Les has mandado algunos? Sí, les he mandado unos cuantos.
cards.back: Have you sent them any? Yes, I've sent them a few.

cards.front: Les mandaron un par a Claudia y Antonio, pero sólo nos mandaron uno.
cards.back: They sent Claudia and Antonio a couple, but they only sent us one.

cards.front: ¿Cuándo se mandó el paquete?
cards.back: When was the parcel sent?

cards.front: ¿Por qué se mandó la investigación?
cards.back: Why was the inquiry sent?

cards.front: ¿Cómo se mandaron las cajas?
cards.back: How were the boxes sent?

cards.front: El paquete se mandó hace tres días.
cards.back: The parcel was sent three days ago.

cards.front: La investigación se mandó para evaluar la situación.
cards.back: The inquiry was sent to assess the situation.

cards.front: Las cajas se mandaron por correo urgente.
cards.back: The boxes were sent by special delivery.

cards.front: ¿Quién mandó el paquete? Exprésalo en pasiva.
cards.back: Who was the parcel sent by?

cards.front: No sé quién mandó el paquete. Exprésalo en pasiva.
cards.back: I don't know who the parcel was sent by.

cards.front: ¿Quién mandó ese correo basura? Exprésalo en pasiva.
cards.back: Who was that piece of junk mail sent by?

cards.front: ¿Cuántos folletos se han mandado en lo que va de semana?
cards.back: How many brochures have been sent so far this week?

cards.front: ¿Adónde se han mandado los folletos?
cards.back: Where have the brochures been sent?

cards.front: ¿Se han mandado ya los otros folletos?
cards.back: Have the other brochures been sent yet?

cards.front: Más o menos 250 folletos se han mandado en lo que va de semana.
cards.back: About two hundred and fifty brochures have been sent so far this week.

cards.front: Los folletos se han mandado por todo el país.
cards.back: The brochures have been sent all across the country.

cards.front: Los otros folletos no se han mandado aún.
cards.back: The other brochures haven't been sent yet.

cards.front: No me mandaron el material a tiempo.
cards.back: I wasn't sent the material in time.

cards.front: ¡Nunca me mandan nada a tiempo!
cards.back: I'm never sent anything in time!

cards.front: Lamentamos que no le enviaran el material a tiempo.
cards.back: We're sorry you weren't sent the material in time.

cards.front: Nos mandaron el artículo equivocado.
cards.back: We were sent the wrong item.

cards.front: A menudo nos mandan artículos equivocados.
cards.back: We're often sent the wrong items.

cards.front: Lamentamos que le enviaran el artículo equivocado.
cards.back: We're sorry you were sent the wrong item.

cards.front: Me mandaron el que no era otra vez.
cards.back: I was sent the wrong one again.

cards.front: No me puedo creer que me mandaran los que no había pedido otra vez.
cards.back: I can't believe I was sent the wrong ones again.

cards.front: Lamentamos muchísimo que le mandaran los que no había pedido otra vez.
cards.back: We're terribly sorry you were sent the wrong ones again.

cards.front: Me mandaron la talla equivocada, así que tuve que devolverlo.
cards.back: I was sent the wrong size, so I had to send it back.

cards.front: Nos mandaron el color equivocado, así que tuvimos que devolverlos.
cards.back: We were sent the wrong colour so we had to send them back.

cards.front: Les mandaron el modelo equivocado, así que tuvieron que devolverlos.
cards.back: They were sent the wrong model so they had to send them back.

cards.front: Y si te mandaron el artículo equivocado, ¿por qué no lo devolviste?
cards.back: Well, if you were sent the wrong item, why didn't you send it back?

cards.front: Si le mandaron a ella los equivocados, ¿por qué no los devolvió?
cards.back: If she was sent the wrong ones, why didn't she send them back?

cards.front: Si nos mandaron la talla equivocada otra vez, ¿por qué no lo devolvemos y no volvemos a utilizar su servicio?
cards.back: If we were sent the wrong size again, why don't we send it back and never use their service again?

cards.front: ¿Puedes mandarnos un e-mail con tus datos bancarios?
cards.back: Can you send us an email with your bank details?

cards.front: Dile a él que me mande un e-mail con sus datos de contacto antes de fin de mes.
cards.back: Tell him to send me an email with his contact details by the end of the month.

cards.front: Te mandaré un e-mail con los datos del pago ahora mismo.
cards.back: I'll send you an email with the payment details right away.

cards.front: ¿Has mandado un recordatorio a propósito del nuevo horario?
cards.back: Have you sent out a reminder regarding the new schedule?

cards.front: No, no he mandado un recordatorio a propósito del nuevo horario.
cards.back: No, I haven't sent out a reminder regarding the new schedule.

cards.front: Dile a él que mande un recordatorio a propósito del nuevo horario ahora mismo.
cards.back: Tell him to send out a reminder regarding the new schedule right away.

cards.front: Creo que te olvidaste de adjuntar los archivos.
cards.back: I think you forgot to attach the files.

cards.front: Disculpa; los archivos ya están adjuntos.
cards.back: Apologies; the files are now attached.

cards.front: Te adjunto los documentos de los que hemos hablado.
cards.back: Please find attached the documents we discussed.

cards.front: Es vital que contestes a este e-mail antes de la fecha límite.
cards.back: It's vital that you reply to this email before the deadline.

cards.front: Es esencial que contestes a este e-mail ahora mismo.
cards.back: It's essential that you reply to this email right away.

cards.front: Es importante que contestes a ese e-mail antes de fin de mes.
cards.back: It's important that you reply to that email by the end of the month.

cards.front: Dile a él que reenvíe a todo el mundo los detalles del pago antes de la fecha límite.
cards.back: Tell him to forward everyone the payment details before the deadline.

cards.front: Es esencial que reenvíes a todo el mundo el e-mail con el nuevo horario adjunto.
cards.back: It's essential that you forward everyone the email with the new schedule attached.

cards.front: Disculpa, les he reenviado el recordatorio, pero se me olvidó adjuntar los documentos.
cards.back: Apologies, I forwarded them the reminder but I forgot to attach the files.

cards.front: ¿Dónde está tu nueva secretaria personal? La mandé a hacer un recado.
cards.back: Where's your new PA? I sent her on an errand.

cards.front: Mandé a mi secretaria personal a hacer un recado, vuelve enseguida.
cards.back: I sent my PA on an errand, she'll be right back.

cards.front: Mi jefe me mandó a hacer un recado, ¡vuelvo enseguida!
cards.back: My boss sent me on an errand, I'll be right back!

cards.front: ¿Tu secretaria personal está fuera otra vez? Sí, la mandé a buscar unas flores.
cards.back: Is your PA out again? Yes, I sent her for some flowers.

cards.front: Su secretaria personal está fuera otra vez, creo que la mandó a buscar unos bombones.
cards.back: His PA is out again, I think he sent her for some chocolates.

cards.front: ¿Por qué mandó a su secretaria personal a buscar flores y bombones?
cards.back: Why did he send his PA for some flowers and chocolates?

cards.front: Él la mandó a buscar un regalo de cumpleaños para su mujer.
cards.back: He sent her to get his wife a birthday present.

cards.front: Me mandó a recoger su ropa de la tintorería y a comprar un regalo de cumpleaños para su mujer cuando estaba volviendo.
cards.back: He sent me to pick up the dry-cleaning and to get his wife a birthday present on my way back.

cards.front: Él también la mandó a recoger a su hija cuando estaba volviendo.
cards.back: He also sent her to pick up his daughter on her way back.

cards.front: ¡No puedo creer que esté pidiendo que venga una masajista!
cards.back: I can't believe he's sending for a massage therapist!

cards.front: ¡Ella no podía creerse que él estuviera pidiendo que viniera un pedicuro!
cards.back: She couldn't believe he was sending for a pedicurist!

cards.front: ¡La secretaria personal se está volviendo loca! ¡Que alguien llame a un médico!
cards.back: The PA is going crazy! Send for a doctor!

cards.front: Él me dijo que encargara unas flores.
cards.back: He told me to send for some flowers.

cards.front: Después me dijo que encargara bombones.
cards.back: Then he told me to send for some chocolates.

cards.front: ¿Por qué encargó flores y bombones?
cards.back: Why did he send for flowers and chocolates?

cards.front: ¿Quién es el que manda por aquí?
cards.back: Who's in charge around here?

cards.front: Yo soy el que manda, así que haz lo que te digo.
cards.back: I'm the one in charge, so do what I tell you.

cards.front: Ella es la que manda, así que hacemos lo que nos dice.
cards.back: She's the one in charge, so we do what she tells us.

cards.front: Nos mandaron callar.
cards.back: We were told to be quiet.

cards.front: Me mandaron salir de la sala inmediatamente.
cards.back: I was told to leave the room immediately.

cards.front: Le mandaron que no lo volviera a hacer.
cards.back: He was told not to do it again.

cards.front: Haz lo que te mandan si no quieres meterte en líos.
cards.back: Do as you're told if you don't want to get into trouble.

cards.front: Ella hizo lo que se le mandó para no meterse en líos.
cards.back: She did as she was told so she didn't get into trouble.

cards.front: Hicimos lo que se nos mandó para no meternos en líos.
cards.back: We did as we were told so we didn't get into trouble.

cards.front: Ella nos mandó que formáramos al becario durante toda la mañana.
cards.back: She had us train the intern all morning.

cards.front: El jefe mandó al becario a que le trajera un café.
cards.back: The boss had the intern bring him a coffee.

cards.front: Ellos les mandaron que se quedaran hasta tarde en el trabajo.
cards.back: They had them stay late at work.

cards.front: Ella no dejaba de meterme en líos, así que la mandé a la mierda.
cards.back: She kept getting me into trouble so I told her to go to hell.

cards.front: Mi compañero de piso no dejaba de meter en líos a su novia, así que ella le mandó a la mierda.
cards.back: My flatmate kept getting his girlfriend into trouble so she told him to go to hell.

cards.front: Él quería estar al mando, así que mandó a su jefe a la mierda.
cards.back: He wanted to be the one in charge, so he told his boss to go to hell.
